author: GamingBolt
description:
CDPR has surprised us all with the announcement of Songs of the Past, a new expansion for Witcher 3: The Wild Hunt that joins a couple of already brilliant ones that were added to the game over the eleven years that it’s been around. But of course, the studio’s penchant for cryptic clues mixed in with facts has once again made its presence felt, and there’s a lot of guesswork about the expansion’s potential story and other details flying around.

We decided to bring everything that’s confirmed to one place for you to check out, while adding our own thoughts about what we’d like to see in this one. Join us as we report and speculate on everything known and unknown about a new chapter for Geralt that might just be his finest one yet.
title: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt - Songs of the Past - NEW Details You May Not Know

author: GamingBolt
description:
Laufey is an opportunity for the franchise to broaden its horizons while still remaining grounded in what earned it the reception it has enjoyed over the years. But it comes with risks that must be considered, as well as skepticism that is certainly valid at this point in the game’s promotional campaign. 

Join us as we try to find a middle ground between delight and despair, examining why Faye’s latest adventure might just win us all over when it drops next year.
title: I Waited A Few Days, Read The Reactions, And Here's What I Think of God of War: Laufey
